{"metadata":{"description":"Give your DeepSeek Harness agent more ways to search the web. Switch between 9 providers in settings, from official DeepSeek and Google results to self-hosted SearXNG. Try Tavily without an API key, or manage your provider keys in one place.","id":"gh:1338104034","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-web-search-plugin","slug":"X-C1811/dsh-web-search-plugin","topics":["brave-search","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","exa","firecrawl","search","search-provider","searxng","serpapi","serper","tavily","web-search","websearch"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Give your DeepSeek Harness agent more ways to search the web. Switch between 9 providers in settings"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", from official DeepSeek and Google results to self-hosted SearXNG. Try Tavily without an API key, o"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"r manage your provider keys in one place."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that gives your agent more search options through Har"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ness's existing `web_search` tool. **Settings → Web search** contains two independent sections: **Se"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"arch engines** (ten choices) and **Web retrieval** (local HTTP or DeepSeek Fetch API), with one Save"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ines** (ten choices) and **Web retrieval** (local HTTP or DeepSeek Fetch API), with one Save action."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why use this plugin?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Avoid an extra DeepSeek model call for search.** DeepSeek Search API and the eight third-party b"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ackends call search APIs directly instead of DeepSeek's official model-backed search endpoint. This "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"avoids the additional DeepSeek model token usage for that search request. (Your conversation and the"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" model's processing of search results still use tokens, and search providers may charge their own fe"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"es or credits.)
- **Configure everything in a settings card.** Switch engines, enter keys, and adjus"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"t result limits in **Settings → Web search**, then save. Changes take effect on the next search with"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"out restarting the plugin or editing YAML.
- **Choose the search service that fits your needs.** Use"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" Google results through Serper, semantic search through Exa, or a self-hosted SearXNG instance. Tavi"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ly's keyless mode lets you try search without an account or API key.
- **Keep existing engines and s"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ettings.** Messages search and third-party engines remain available. Search and retrieval are select"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ed independently; see Disable or uninstall before removing saved provider overrides."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**The default engine is still DeepSeek Messages search.** To avoid the extra official search model c"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"all, select **DeepSeek Search API** or a third-party engine in the settings card after installation "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"and save your changes. Selecting DeepSeek Messages search uses the official search API and may incur"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" model invocation charges."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Supported providers"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **DeepSeek Search API** — Reuses rc.2's official `deepseek-search-api`. Direct `/v1/tools/search` "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"requests without an auxiliary model turn. Its `count` is 1–50 (default 10), further bounded by the c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"alling tool; it does not use this plugin's `maxResults`.
- **DeepSeek Messages search (installation "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"default)** — Uses DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible Messages API with the native search tool type `web"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"_search_20250305`. Supports account tokens or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Each search sends a model request "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"and may incur model invocation charges.
- **Tavily** — Supports `keyless` access (free, rate-limited"},{"id":"p9s7","text":", no account required) or `keyed` access (`TAVILY_API_KEY`, Bearer token). The settings card shows a"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" quota bar in keyed mode.
- **Brave Search** — Calls `GET https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/se"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"arch` with the `X-Subscription-Token` header (credential name: `BRAVE_API_KEY`). Each search is one "},{"id":"p9s10","text":"HTTP request and does not consume a model turn. The settings card displays Capacity and monthly quot"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"a from response headers.
- **Serper** — Google results via `POST /search`, using the `X-API-KEY` hea"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"der (credential name: `SERPER_API_KEY`).
- **SerpApi** — Calls `GET /search.json` with the key in th"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"e query string (`api_key=`; credential name: `SERPAPI_API_KEY`).
- **Exa** — Semantic/neural search "},{"id":"p9s14","text":"via `POST /search` with Bearer authentication (credential name: `EXA_API_KEY`). Requests `contents.h"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"ighlights` for result summaries.
- **SearXNG** — Metasearch with no API key required by the protocol"},{"id":"p9s16","text":". Calls `GET /search?format=json` and supports a self-hosted instance URL. The instance must enable "},{"id":"p9s17","text":"JSON output.
- **Scavio** — Google SERP via `POST /api/v2/google` with Bearer authentication (creden"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"tial name: `SCAVIO_API_KEY`). Uses the same response structure as SerpApi.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Verified with DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`. New Search / Fetch options require the Host's `web` a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"nd `web-deepseek-api` configuration namespaces. Compatible `0.2.0-rc.2` Hosts retain existing engine"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"s; unavailable API options are disabled.
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`
- pnpm, used by `dsh plu"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"gin` to install the plugin into a profile"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The plugin registers a single `WebSearchProvider` with the stable ID `dsh-web-search` through `ctx.w"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"eb`, following the same provider contract as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` (`inject: ['web'"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"]` and `ctx.web.registerSearchProvider`). The original nine engines share this provider; selecting t"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"he new Search API switches to the official provider, independently of retrieval. Results are normali"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"zed to `WebSearchResult` (optional `content` and `sources[]`) and deduplicated by URL. All configura"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"tion fields use `volatile()`, so saved settings are read without restarting the plugin."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This package is a **bundle**. The `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration points to `cordis.patch.yml`, which"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" adds the Host entry, selects `dsh-web-search`, and disables the built-in `web-search-deepseek` Host"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" plugin while the bundle is enabled. The plugin's internal `deepseek-official` engine option is dist"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"inct from its registered `dsh-web-search` ID. Disabling the entire bundle removes this patch layer; "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"disabling only its Host entry does not. Without a bundle declaration, `dsh plugin add` only adds the"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" dependency and does not mount the plugin."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **DeepSeek** — Calls `POST {deepseekBaseURL}/messages` with the `web_search_20250305` tool. If the"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" session uses the official DeepSeek account route (provider: `deepseek-account`) and the account ser"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"vice allows the endpoint, the request uses an account token in `x-dsh-auth-token`. Otherwise, it fal"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ls back to an API key (`x-api-key` / `authorization: Bearer`, credential name: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`). "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"When a session initiator is available, a redacted request is recorded as the session event `web/deep"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"seek-search-llm-request` before dispatch.
- **REST backends (Tavily / Brave / Serper / SerpApi / Exa"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" / SearXNG / Scavio / Firecrawl)** — Driven by a static metadata table (`lib/providers.js`) and a sh"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ared backend (`lib/rest.js`). Table rows define the request method, path, query field names, authent"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ication (`bearer` / `header` / `none` / `query`), fixed parameters, and response shape. REST backend"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"s do not append custom session events.
